items.text: REMINDER: Today is the final day to enroll in health insurance through the ACA marketplace. With new support from the #AmericanRescuePlan, you may find that coverage is less expensive than you think – find the best plan for you at https://t.co/QqiGyLY5nS or call 1-866-636-0355.

In Maine, this has meant millions to support rural hospitals, expand broadband access, and create good-paying jobs. You can find more information about the $4.6 billion Maine will be receiving from the #AmericanRescuePlan here: https://t.co/SGfsAmIFwQ

The ACA healthcare marketplace is OPEN! Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, coverage is more affordable for most Maine people. Sign up by December 15th to get insurance on January 1st – go to https://t.co/vvSfLMqI3N or call 1-866-636-0355 to find a plan that works for you. https://t.co/weh7Cj0job

Good news for Maine seniors: Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, insulin is now capped at $35/month for Medicare Part D recipients. I’m proud to have supported this historic bill, which is already bringing down healthcare costs for Maine families. https://t.co/MfcI3Sunaj

REMINDER: today is the final day to enroll for healthcare through the ACA marketplace. Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, coverage is more affordable for most Maine people. Sign up TODAY, go to https://t.co/vvSfLMqI3N or call 1-866-636-0355 to find a plan that works for you.

The new @BealUniversity nursing program in Wilton is helping to address a shortage of healthcare personnel in rural areas. I visited the campus last week and am excited this program will mean so much for wellness in Maine communities.
 
https://t.co/DVafut5aRB

Telemedicine has become a vital service for Maine people, bringing quality healthcare to the comfort of our homes. On “Inside Maine”, I spoke with healthcare leaders about the opportunities for our state and challenges of telehealth moving forward. https://t.co/LtumIT7jez

As we brace for dangerously cold weather this weekend, it’s important to be informed, stay prepared, and exercise caution when going outside. Make sure to check @MaineEMA’s website for updates, guidance, and warming shelter locations. https://t.co/bCyhfBMtzP

Are you covered by MaineCare? With recent federal changes and the COVID-19 public health emergency ending tomorrow, it may mean changes to your eligibility. Go to https://t.co/AEvncmBZTP to check your coverage status. https://t.co/3Z8G5Ob62h
Maine nurses are dedicated, compassionate, and hard working. This #NationalNursesWeek, I hope you can join me in thanking these healthcare workers for keeping our communities healthy and strong.

From healthcare databases to water systems, every industry and utility in the 21st century faces cyberthreats. We've made real progress over the last few years, but we need to keep working to protect our networks against shifting tactics from bad actors.
https://t.co/lWPsp7Jny6

Maine needs better access to mental healthcare, especially in our most rural areas. The bipartisan Improving Access to Mental Health Act would be an important step to expand critical care across our state's communities. https://t.co/8ULBqEOMEv

Great to see Maine Guardsmen leading the way – the MAINEiacs are participating in the Arctic Challenge, an exercise to boost cooperation among the United States, allies and partners against foreign adversaries in the High North.
https://t.co/fdy9jEDaoh

Maine healthcare providers are paving the way for remote patient monitoring. Thanks to their innovative telehealth approaches, our state's rural seniors can now receive more consistent medical attention and care.
https://t.co/aMzbz1S6Z4

Touring the brand-new Northern Light Blue Hill Hospital, I saw the incredible work of our state's rural medical professionals. Thanks to their hard work and this state-of-the-art facility, Maine people on the Blue Hill Peninsula continue to have critical access to healthcare https://t.co/FI527t41SO

With Maine people facing high healthcare costs, the #InflationReductionAct is helping to lower the price of prescription drugs. 

This a commonsense move that tens of thousands of Maine people will benefit from. More here ⬇️

https://t.co/PYVWYTwsoL

There are innocent civilians in Gaza that need our help. Since many of their hospitals are overrun by Hamas terrorists, America needs to help them get the care they need. Sending a hospital ship offshore to provide care would make a difference in their lives. https://t.co/nJx1AVoe2r

Every Maine person deserves access to fresh and healthy foods.

I'm proud to support @MaineHealth by securing $119K to fund a one-stop food shop refrigerated van to help remove barriers to nutrition and address food insecurity in the Portland community.
https://t.co/1NVpQpgNCK

As the state with the most forest coverage, Maine has deep cultural and economic roots in our expansive forests. I am proud to join @SenatorRisch in recognizing the 152nd Arbor Day to honor environmental stewardship and to maintain our forests for years to come. https://t.co/GbMMR1xbwT

Proud to work alongside my friend @SenatorBennet and a bipartisan group of our colleagues to ensure the VA is properly staffed to take care of our veterans. 

From Maine to Colorado, and everywhere in between, we owe those who served the very best medical treatment.

Broadband means access to work, school & healthcare — no matter where you live. This month, I spoke with @abutcherhere of @MEConnectivity & @Sen_JoeManchin about how we can expand affordable connectivity in Maine, West Virginia & beyond.

Listen here ➡️🛜 https://t.co/XPHqICZ2tY https://t.co/lFR2PRiVFl

The government finally negotiating drug prices is just common sense. Now, thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, Medicare will save $6B annually and older Americans can afford some of the medications they need — a win-win across the board. https://t.co/JhSpWqFgVF

Rural Maine already faces many hurdles when accessing affordable healthcare. This grant will help keep our rural hospitals open and ensure communities get the care they need. Investing in the health of Maine people is investing in the future of Maine. https://t.co/bnP1UxgH9q

For 60 years, the Economic Opportunity Act has made tremendous investments in Maine. Thank you to the Aroostook County Action Program for inviting me to hear from partner agencies about its impacts today on education, the workforce and community wellness. https://t.co/Ab4pM7aIkI

🚨Medicare Open Enrollment begins today and runs through December 7. For everyone in Maine eligible for Medicare, this is a great opportunity to compare different plans to help save money and find quality care.
 
Learn more about Medicare Enrollment ⬇️
https://t.co/nwduzl7hW0
